 $('routeProgress').textContent=cleared+' of '+LEVELS.length+' cleared'+(canSave?'':' · On this visit');
 const first=Number(chartPicker.value)*PORTS_PER_CHART;
 LEVELS.slice(first,first+PORTS_PER_CHART).forEach((level,offset)=>{
  const i=first+offset;
  const unlocked=i<=cleared,done=i<cleared,current=i===s.level;
  const row=document.createElement('button');row.type='button';row.className='routeStop';row.disabled=!unlocked;
  if(current)row.setAttribute('aria-current','step');
  const thumb=document.createElement('canvas');thumb.width=W*4;thumb.height=H*4;thumb.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');chartThumbnail(thumb,chart(i),i);
  const copy=document.createElement('span'),name=document.createElement('strong'),goal=document.createElement('small');
  name.textContent=(i+1)+'. '+level.name;goal.textContent=level.mapHint;
  copy.append(name,goal);
  const state=document.createElement('b');state.textContent=!unlocked?'Locked':done?'Cleared ✓':current?'Current':'Unlocked';
  row.append(thumb,copy,state);row.onclick=()=>choosePort(i);list.append(row);
 });
}
function closeRoute(resume){
 $('voyage').close();$('switchRun').hidden=true;mapPick=null;
 if(resume&&mapStartedFromPlay&&s.mode==='pause')action();
 mapStartedFromPlay=false;
}
function startPort(level){
 if(level>cleared||level<0||level>=LEVELS.length)return;
 closeRoute(false);s=freshState(level);terrain=null;particles=[];popups=[];last=0;sync();draw();
 $('action').focus({preventScroll:true});
}
function choosePort(level){
 playerInput();
 if(level===s.level&&!['won','over','clear'].includes(s.mode)){closeRoute(true);return;}
 if(level>cleared)return;
 if(!['ready','won','over'].includes(s.mode)){
  mapPick=level;$('switchText').textContent='Start a new run in '+LEVELS[level].name+' with three lives?';
  $('switchRun').hidden=false;$('newVoyage').focus();return;
 }
 startPort(level);
}
$('route').onclick=()=>{
 if(!hostChannel)return;playerInput();mapStartedFromPlay=s.mode==='play';
 if(mapStartedFromPlay){s.mode='pause';sync();}
 mapPick=null;$('switchRun').hidden=true;chartPicker.value=String(chartIndex(s.level));renderRoute();$('voyage').showModal();
};
$('closeRoute').onclick=()=>closeRoute(true);
$('voyage').addEventListener('cancel',e=>{e.preventDefault();closeRoute(true);});
$('newVoyage').onclick=()=>{if(mapPick!==null)startPort(mapPick);};
$('stay').onclick=()=>{mapPick=null;$('switchRun').hidden=true;};

// The maze accepts a turn once and keeps sailing until the next one.
let padIndex = null, lastPad = null, nextPadCheck = 0, usedPad = false;
const padHint = $('padHint');
function padHeading(pad, previous) {
  const held = i => !!pad.buttons[i]?.pressed;
  let x = Number(held(15)) - Number(held(14));
  let y = Number(held(13)) - Number(held(12));
  if (!x && !y) {
    x = Number(pad.axes[0]) || 0;
    y = Number(pad.axes[1]) || 0;
    if (Math.max(Math.abs(x),Math.abs(y)) < (previous ? .35 : .55)) return null;
  }
  const horizontal = previous === 'left' || previous === 'right';
  const bias = previous ? (horizontal ? 1 / axisBias : axisBias) : 1;
  return Math.abs(x) > Math.abs(y) * bias ? (x < 0 ? 'left' : 'right') : (y < 0 ? 'up' : 'down');
}
function forgetPad() {
  if (usedPad) suspend();
  usedPad = false;
  padIndex = null;
  lastPad = null;
  padHint.hidden = true;
}
function readPad(now) {
  if (!hostChannel || !document.hasFocus() || now < nextPadCheck || typeof navigator.getGamepads !== 'function') return;
  let pads;
  try { pads = Array.from(navigator.getGamepads()); }
  catch { forgetPad(); nextPadCheck = now + 1000; return; }
  const supported = pad => pad?.connected && pad.mapping === 'standard';
  const pad = pads.find(pad => supported(pad) && pad.index === padIndex) || pads.find(supported);
  if (!pad) { forgetPad(); nextPadCheck = now + 750; return; }
  if (pad.index !== padIndex) {
    forgetPad();
    padIndex = pad.index;
    padHint.hidden = false;
  }
  const current = {
    heading: padHeading(pad,lastPad?.heading),
    action: !!pad.buttons[0]?.pressed,
    pause: !!pad.buttons[9]?.pressed
  };
  const previous = lastPad;
  lastPad = current;
  // A button held while opening the frame or returning to it must first be released.
  if (!previous || $('guide').open || $('voyage').open) return;
  if (current.pause && !previous.pause && (s.mode === 'play' || s.mode === 'pause')) {
    usedPad = true;
    playerInput();
    pause();
    return;
  }
  if (current.action && !previous.action) {
    usedPad = true;
    if (s.mode !== 'play') { action(); return; }
    if (!$('flare').disabled) fire();
  }
  if (current.heading && current.heading !== previous.heading && s.mode === 'play' && stickPointer === null && touch === null) {
    usedPad = true;
    aim(current.heading);
  }
}
addEventListener('gamepadconnected',()=>{ nextPadCheck = 0; });
addEventListener('gamepaddisconnected',e=>{ if (e.gamepad.index === padIndex) forgetPad(); });
addEventListener('focus',()=>{ lastPad = null; nextPadCheck = 0; });

function frame(now){
 const dt=last?Math.min((now-last)/1000,.08):0;last=now;
 if(!document.hidden){
  readPad(now);
  if(s.mode==='play'&&!awaitingHeading){clock+=dt;const parts=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(dt*90));for(let i=0;i<parts;i++)tick(s,dt/parts,emit);bestScore();}
  for(const p of particles){p.x+=p.vx*dt;p.y+=p.vy*dt;p.life-=dt;}particles=particles.filter(p=>p.life>0);
  for(const p of popups)p.life-=dt;popups=popups.filter(p=>p.life>0);
  draw();sync();
 }
 requestAnimationFrame(frame);
}
buildTerrain();sync();draw();requestAnimationFrame(frame);
